name: DistractBlocker
description: Connects to the DistractBlocker desktop app to block sites right inside Firefox, and add sites to your Block Profiles from any page.
_comment: Firefox has no 'key'-pinning like Chrome — its extension id instead comes from browser_specific_settings.gecko.id above (must match FIREFOX_EXTENSION_ID in the Desktop app's src/extensionDiskCheck.js). Background uses 'scripts' (Firefox's event-page style) instead of Chrome's 'service_worker' — everything else in this package is shared as-is with the Chrome/Edge/Opera build. For a temporary 'Load Temporary Add-on' test in about:debugging, Firefox assigns a random internal id per session unless this is a permanent signed install — see README.md.
